name: magnetic
title: Magnetic
description: Pulls a button or icon toward the pointer on a spring when the cursor comes close.

props.name: children
props.description: The element to pull, usually a button or an icon link.

props.name: strength
props.description: Share of the pointer's offset the child follows, from 0 to 1.

props.name: radius
props.description: Pixels around the child where the pull starts.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Turns the pull off. It is also off on touch devices and under reduced motion.
